items.new_text: Given a test file whose suites contain text that only looks like curly braces (inside a string, a pattern, a comment or a template), when the requirement names given to a suite are collected, then every test inside that suite receives them and no test after it does; a requirement comment that reaches no test or suite is reported as a warning naming it and never stops the change; and when finishing stops on an untagged test whose body changed, the message names both ways out: name the requirement the test proves, or add or extend a requirement in the same change.
